quotes.text: 1a. ¿En la semana pasada, trabajó por lo menos una hora? (sin contar las tareas de su hogar)
... no podía trabajar por razones personales? (cuidado del hogar, estudios, incapacidad)
1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?

assessments.reasoning: The survey explicitly excludes household tasks from the definition of work in question 1a of the individual questionnaire ("sin contar las tareas de su hogar") and treats domestic care as a reason for not working/inactivity in question 1e ("cuidado del hogar"). In the household questionnaire (Section VII), questions ask who performs most household tasks and who helps, but this is a household-level identification rather than individual questions recording domestic/care work separately for each person. Per the indicator rules, household-level questions and mentions as inactivity/reasons for not working do not satisfy the requirement.
